title: TROUBLESHOOTING

TROUBLESHOOTING

Trouble
• Hard steering at idle or low-speed driving.
• Steering too sensitive during high-speed driving.

Preliminary Check
• Check tire pressure.
• Check lubrication of suspension and steering linkage.
• Check front wheel alignment.
• Check steering system joint and suspension arm ball joint.
• Check for bent steering column.
• Check that all connectors are secure.
• Check PS pump fluid pressure. (See page SR-43)

Turn ignition switch on.

Is ECU1G fuse normal?

Yes

No

Replace fuse.
Is operation normal?

Yes

Fuse faulty.

No

Short circuit in wire harness between fuse and ECU terminal +B.

Disconnect the ECU connector.

Check 1.
Check that there is the battery voltage between the ECU terminal +B and body ground.

Yes

No

Open circuit in wire harness between the fuse and ECU terminal +B.
